title: Where does the learning-off probe path leave the training path at the first burst after 481,800?
question: From checkpoint 481,800's saved state, with learning off and the finger fix off, at which stage does the probe path (one body per model update on the processor) part from the training path (control runs 1 and 2, equal to each other through model step 481,806) at the first burst, does the skipped learning update cause the first command difference, and do the probe path's movement and sensor readings still match training's within differences declared beforehand?
about: The operator's decisions: received by 7:29 AM PDT, Oct 9, 2026, trace the first-burst difference with the same saved body states, commands, timing and physics settings, learning off, the finger fix off; correct differences that change movement; verify movement and sensor readings before stop limits are set. Received by 8:53 AM PDT, Oct 9: replay training's exact update on a separate checkpoint copy and compare its command with training's recorded command; match the learning-off measurement statistically, spread and largest errors included, against differences declared beforehand; keep the planner's 23-degree jump a separate defect. The walk reads the measurements made under a substitution first (the world driven with training's commands, twice; training's own model step replayed, twice, on both code versions and with learning off), then the probe path's instrument (the twin check: the pilot's own loop and the instrumented one in one process, handed the same pictures), then its own computation and goal, then the statistical match. elimination.py lists a stage followed by a met stage as gone around, so a substituted measurement read after one of the probe path's own would seem to carry its signal past it; read first, each decides only its own candidate. A learning-off stage that reads not met followed by met statistics is listed as gone around, which here is the outcome the operator's rule accepts: the command differs, the statistics match. Control run 2 is the reference: the observer daemon's 72-hour housekeeping removed control run 1's first world and model records at 9:07 AM PDT, Oct 9; control run 2's equal them through 481,806 and every run's records are read from copies made at 9:23 AM PDT. Four rows decide the stages (drafts in D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_scratch/finger_investigation/probe_path/rows_v2/): probe_path_world_same_command_481800, probe_path_update_replay_481800, probe_path_command_481800 and probe_path_learning_off_match_481800; the twin row probe_path_instrumentation_twin_481800 decides the instrument's two stages (draft in D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_scratch/finger_investigation/probe_path/rows_v3/), and the command and verification rows' records are re-judged under the repeat rule with its result by probe_path_command_rejudge_481800 and probe_path_learning_off_match_rejudge_481800 (drafts in D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_scratch/finger_investigation/probe_path/rows_v4/); all run by docs/gain_of_function_v4/probe_path_investigation/probe_path_trace.py (the trainer arms by update_replay.py beside it). Design note: PROBE_PATH_FIRST_BURST_DESIGN.md beside the tool.
written_by: the probe path investigator (agent), branch investigate/probe-path-first-burst-2026-10-09; the twin's stages and the re-judgement rows on branch investigate/probe-path-rejudge-fixes-2026-10-09

PASS.text: Movement and sensor readings match training's within the declared differences: the stop limits can be set on the probe path's readings.

FAIL.text: The sensor readings named lie outside training's range: no stop limit is set on them until the difference is corrected or the operator decides how the limits carry it.
